ci_support_linux_64_cuda_compiler_versio:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cuda_compiler:
- cuda-nvcc
cuda_compiler_version:
- '12.9'
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.10.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
  - c_stdlib_version
  - cuda_compiler_version
name: cupy
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cupy
  version: "14.2.0"
  sha256: cfed725e612178cfbdbf62f4a3a598b60edecbbca718c0d4580c21a16ae4a62c
  number: 2
  target_name: ${{ "sbsa-linux" if aarch64 else 'ppc64le-linux' if ppc64le else 'x86_64-linux' if linux else "x64" if win else "" }}
  cuda_compiler_version: ${{ cuda_compiler_version if cuda_compiler_version is defined else "None" }}
  cuda_major: ${{ 0 if cuda_compiler_version == "None" else (cuda_compiler_version | split("."))[0] | int }}
  conda_override_cuda: ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: ${{ sha256 }}

build:
  # For CUDA 12, the compiler version is hard-coded in the cuda120.yaml migrator
  number: ${{ number }}
  skip: match(python, "<3.10") or cuda_compiler_version not in ("12.9", "13.2") or ppc64le

outputs:
  - package:
      name: cupy
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # For CUDA 12, the compiler version is hard-coded in the cuda120.yaml migrator
      number: ${{ number }}
      skip: match(python, "<3.10") or cuda_compiler_version not in ("12.9", "13.2") or ppc64le
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
        - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('cupy-core', exact=True) }}
        - cuda-cudart-dev_${{ target_platform }}
        - cuda-nvrtc
        - libcublas
        - libcufft
        - libcurand
        - libcusolver
        - libcusparse
        # see discussions/references in conda-forge/cupy-feedstock#247
        - ${{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", lower_bound="x") }}
    tests:
      - script: run_test.py
        files:
          source:
            - tests
        requirements:
          run:
            - if: linux
              # need the libcuda stub for import test
              then: cuda-driver-dev
    about:
      license: MIT
      license_file: LICENSE
      summary: |
        CuPy: NumPy & SciPy for GPU
      homepage: https://cupy.dev/
      repository: https://github.com/cupy/cupy/
      documentation: https://docs.cupy.dev/en/stable/
  - package:
      name: cupy-core
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      # For CUDA 12, the compiler version is hard-coded in the cuda120.yaml migrator
      number: ${{ number }}
      skip: match(python, "<3.10") or cuda_compiler_version not in ("12.9", "13.2") or ppc64le
      script:
        env:
          CONDA_OVERRIDE_CUDA: ${{ conda_override_cuda }}
          CUDA_COMPILER_VERSION: ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
          CUDA_MAJOR: ${{ cuda_major }}
          CUPY_NUM_BUILD_JOBS: 1
          TARGET_NAME: ${{ target_name }}
        file: ${{ 'build_output.bat' if win else 'build_output.sh' if linux else '' }}
      dynamic_linking:
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          - if: linux
            then: "*/libcuda.*"
          - if: win
            then: "*/nvcuda.dll"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
          - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
          - python
          - cython >=3.2,!=3.2.6,<3.3
          - numpy 2.*
          - setuptools >=77
          - if: linux
            then: cuda-driver-dev
          - cuda-cudart-dev
          - cuda-nvrtc-dev
          - cuda-nvtx-dev
          - cuda-profiler-api
          - libcublas-dev
          - libcufft-dev
          - libcurand-dev
          - libcusolver-dev
          - libcusparse-dev
          # optional dependencies for CUDA 11.2+
          - if: linux
            then: nccl ~=2.17
          - cutensor ~=2.0
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools >=77
        - cython >=3.2,!=3.2.6,<3.3
        - numpy 2.*
        - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
        - if: linux
          then: cuda-driver-dev
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-cudart-static
        - cuda-nvrtc-dev
        - cuda-nvtx-dev
        - cuda-profiler-api
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcufft-dev
        - libcurand-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcusparse-dev
        # optional dependencies
        - if: linux
          then: nccl ~=2.17
        - cutensor ~=2.0
      run:
        - python
        - cuda-pathfinder >=1.3.4,<2.0a0
        - numpy >=2.0
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - if: linux
            then: nccl
          - cutensor
        from_package:
          - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
          - if: linux
            then: cuda-driver-dev
          - cuda-cudart-dev
          - cuda-cudart-static
          - cuda-nvrtc-dev
          - cuda-nvtx-dev
          - cuda-profiler-api
          - libcublas-dev
          - libcufft-dev
          - libcurand-dev
          - libcusolver-dev
          - libcusparse-dev
      run_constraints:
        - ${{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", lower_bound="x") }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('cuda-nvrtc', lower_bound='x', upper_bound='x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('libcublas', lower_bound='x', upper_bound='x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('libcufft', lower_bound='x', upper_bound='x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('libcurand', lower_bound='x', upper_bound='x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('libcusolver', lower_bound='x', upper_bound='x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('libcusparse', lower_bound='x', upper_bound='x') }}
        - scipy >=1.14,<1.18
        - optuna >=3.0
        - __cuda >=${{ cuda_major }}.0
        - if: linux
          then: ${{ pin_compatible('nccl') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('cutensor') }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - cupy
          pip_check: true
    about:
      license: MIT
      license_file: LICENSE
      summary: |
        CuPy: NumPy & SciPy for GPU
      description: |
        This is the CuPy core package without any dependencies on the CUDA libraries, suitable for
        deployment under resource constraint. You need to install the needed dependencies explicitly.
      homepage: https://cupy.dev/
      repository: https://github.com/cupy/cupy/
      documentation: https://docs.cupy.dev/en/stable/

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: |
